en: Black‑and‑white landscape-format image showing a large hilltop castle complex overlooking a small town. The fortress has tall multi‑storey stone buildings with steep gabled roofs and several small towers or spires. Below the castle are clustered half‑timbered or plastered houses with pitched roofs, gardens, and terraced slopes, surrounded by leafless trees and countryside. The overall look is that of a historic European castle dominating a rural town.
